import json,copy,work
with open('requests.json') as f:r=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json') as f:e=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f:p=json.load(f)
rb,eb,pb=copy.deepcopy(r),copy.deepcopy(e),copy.deepcopy(p)
out=[work.evaluate(x,e,p) for x in r]
with open('report.json') as f:report=json.load(f)
assert out==report
assert (r,e,p)==(rb,eb,pb)
# missing conditions
assert work.evaluate({'claim':'x','conditions':{}},[],{'required_conditions':['z','a']})=={'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','z']}
# verified filtering and no evidence
assert work.evaluate({'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1}},[{'source':'u','claim':'x','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1}}],{'required_conditions':['a'],'require_verified':True})['unknowns']==['no matching evidence']
# eligible supersession
ev=[{'source':'old','claim':'x','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'x','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1},'verified':True,'supersedes':'old'}]
assert work.evaluate({'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1}},ev,{'required_conditions':['a'],'require_verified':True})=={'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]}
# disagreement, canonical object equality, and bool false
ev2=[{'source':'b','claim':'x','value':{'q':1,'p':2},'conditions':{}},{'source':'a','claim':'x','value':{'p':2,'q':1},'conditions':{}}]
assert work.evaluate({'claim':'x','conditions':{}},ev2,{'required_conditions':[]})=={'status':'supported','value':{'q':1,'p':2},'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':[]}
ev2[1]['value']=False
assert work.evaluate({'claim':'x','conditions':{}},ev2,{'required_conditions':[]})=={'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']}
assert work.evaluate({'claim':'x','conditions':{}},[{'source':'s','claim':'x','value':False,'conditions':{}}],{'required_conditions':[]})['status']=='unsupported'
print('all checks passed')
